extracted.name: Pork, Broccoli and Rice Casserole
extracted.description: I made this pork and broccoli dish one night when I had leftover pork roast cooked in my slow cooker and frozen. Pork, broccoli, and rice with a hint of curry. It's very homey and easy to make ahead of time.
ingredient_lines: 2 (10.75 ounce) cans condensed cream of celery soup
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Bring water and rice to a boil in a saucepan over medium-high heat. Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer until rice is tender, about 20 minutes.
Combine pork, cooked rice, and broccoli in a large bowl. Stir in soup and mayonnaise; season with pepper and curry powder. Transfer to a 9x13-inch baking dish; cover with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until evenly heated through, 45 to 50 minutes. Remove foil for the last 5 minutes.
